description: Bundles seven ordinary control signals into one MPX note stream, reading them all on the gate's rising edge and holding them for the life of the note

params.text: Sets the level of a note when nothing is patched to the level input, 0 to 100%
Sets the length of a note when nothing is patched to the duration input, 0.01 to 30 seconds, exponential so the short end has most of the travel
Sets the placing of a note across the stereo field when nothing is patched to the pan input, hard left to hard right
Declares how many semitones count as full bend deflection, 0 to 12, and travels with every note so the receiving end needs no matching setting; fractions are allowed
Chooses whether a note ends at its own duration whatever the gate does, or at whichever of the gate's fall and the duration comes first

inputs.text: A rising edge starts a note and the whole note is read at that instant; it reads high above 2V and low below 0.1V, and it is polyphonic, one note per channel
Sets the pitch of a note at its start, and afterwards any movement here is sent as bend measured from where the note began
Sets the level of a note, 0 to 10V mapping to none to full, read once at the note's start; the knob is used instead when nothing is patched
Sets the length of a note in seconds, one volt to the second, read once at the note's start; the knob is used instead when nothing is patched
Sets the placing of a note across the stereo field, -5V to 5V for hard left to hard right, read once at the note's start; the knob is used instead when nothing is patched
Sends pressure for a note that is already sounding, 0 to 10V, and with nothing patched here no pressure is sent at all rather than a stream of zeros
Sends timbre for a note that is already sounding, 0 to 10V, and with nothing patched here no timbre is sent at all rather than a stream of zeros

outputs.text: Carries the note stream to an MPX input; it is not a voltage, so a scope or a mixer reads nothing from it

notes: a bare gate makes a complete note, because every value not patched is taken from its knob
the pitch read at the note's start is held for the life of the note, so a source that keeps moving afterwards bends the note instead of dragging it
mpx OUT carries a note stream, not a voltage; patch it to the mpx IN of another DreamerMPX module, and use fromMPX where ordinary voltages are wanted again
a cable between two MPX jacks turns pink once it has taken; a cable from an MPX jack to anything else keeps its ordinary colour and carries nothing
no note is sent until a rising edge arrives at the gate input
an MPX cable carries a note stream rather than a voltage and goes to an MPX input; fromMPX turns a stream back into gates and pitch for the wider rack
